dundee.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Tayside
s1loc: Dundee anchors live entertainment on the Tay. The imposing Caird Hall fills City Square for orchestral nights and big tours, the open-air Slessor Gardens stages outdoor concerts on the waterfront beside the V and A, Dundee Rep runs as the home of the city's repertory and dance companies, and Fat Sam's has rocked three floors of the city centre since the 1980s, drawing touring acts, rising local bands and packed DJ sets to South Ward Road.

And the trade runs at every size here. Major venues, festival operators and production companies run large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around the waterfront and the wider Tayside scene need just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the big concert and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

Cambridge adds a layer of events the colleges make unique. The West Road Concert Hall and the ADC Theatre run year-round, Parker's Piece and Midsummer Common turn into big open-air event sites for funfairs and live nights, and every June the May Balls fill the college courts with marquees, staging and crews through the small hours. The Cambridge Film Festival and a busy summer of open-air Shakespeare in the college gardens keep production and front-of-house teams working right across the city.
